rules.vcep: ENIGMA BRCA1 and BRCA2 Variant Curation Expert Panel
rules.score_definition_stated: not stated: the criterion names SpliceAI and its cut point only, and refers to the specification's Figure 1A and Appendix J, which the registry's record does not carry
rules.position_scope: intronic variants outside the donor and acceptor 1,2 sites
rules.quote: Apply PP3 for predicted splicing (SpliceAI ≥0.2) for silent, missense/in-frame (irrespective of location in clinically important functional domain) and for intronic variants outside of donor and acceptor 1,2 sites.

rules.vcep: ENIGMA BRCA1 and BRCA2 Variant Curation Expert Panel
rules.score_definition_stated: not stated: the criterion names SpliceAI and its cut point only, and refers to the specification's Figure 1A and Appendix J, which the registry's record does not carry
rules.position_scope: intronic variants outside the native donor and acceptor splice sites (not the +/-1,2 positions)
rules.quote: Intronic variants outside of the native donor and acceptor splice sites (i.e. not +/- 1,2 positions) AND no predicted impact via splicing (SpliceAI ≤0.1).

rules.vcep: ENIGMA BRCA1 and BRCA2 Variant Curation Expert Panel
rules.score_definition_stated: not stated: the criterion names SpliceAI and its cut point only, and refers to the specification's Figure 1A and Appendix J, which the registry's record does not carry
rules.position_scope: intronic variants at or beyond +7 (donor side) and -21 (acceptor side)
rules.quote: Intronic variants located outside conserved donor or acceptor motif positions (at or beyond positions +7/-21) IF BP4 met.

further_quotes.quote: Following convention, this code is applied in addition to BP4 (no splicing prediction, Splice AI ≤0.1) to capture the low prior probability of pathogenicity of silent variants.

rules.vcep: Hereditary Breast, Ovarian and Pancreatic Cancer Variant Curation Expert Panel
rules.score_definition_stated: the SVI's thresholds, Walker et al. 2023 (instructions to use)
rules.position_scope: intronic variants outside the donor and acceptor 1,2 sites
extra_conditions: not applied in addition to PVS1 or PVS1_Variable(RNA) (no PVS1 or RNA evidence enters this analysis)
rules.quote: Splicing: Predicted impact via splicing (SpliceAI **≥0.2**) for silent, missense/in-frame and for intronic variants outside of donor and acceptor 1,2 sites.

further_quotes.quote: This VCEP recommends SpliceAI thresholds set forth by the SVI in applying PP3 and BP4 to non-canonical splice variants: Apply PP3 for SpliceAI scores ≥0.2 and apply BP4 for SpliceAI scores ≤0.1 (Walker et al., 2023).
NOTE: PP3 for splice predictions may not be applied in addition to PVS1 or PVS1\_Variable(RNA) codes.

rules.vcep: Hereditary Breast, Ovarian and Pancreatic Cancer Variant Curation Expert Panel
rules.score_definition_stated: the SVI's thresholds, Walker et al. 2023 (instructions to use)
rules.position_scope: non-canonical splice variants (instructions to use), missense variants excluded
extra_conditions: with RNA data, the instructions to use allow BP4 with BP7_Variable(RNA) and the comments do not (the v1.3 release notes say it is allowed); no RNA evidence enters this analysis
rules.quote: Splicing: No predicted impact via splicing (SpliceAI **≤0.1**). Do not apply for missense variants.

further_quotes.quote: This VCEP recommends SpliceAI thresholds set forth by the SVI in applying PP3 and BP4 to non-canonical splice variants: Apply PP3 for SpliceAI scores ≥0.2 and apply BP4 for SpliceAI scores ≤0.1 (Walker et al., 2023).
NOTE: BP4 for splice predictions may be applied in conjunction with BP7\_Variable(RNA) (a lack of observed RNA defect)
NOTE: BP4 for splice predictions may not be applied in conjunction with BP7_Variable(RNA) (a lack of observed RNA defect)

rules.vcep: Hereditary Breast, Ovarian and Pancreatic Cancer Variant Curation Expert Panel
rules.tool: none stated in the criterion's text
rules.position_scope: deep intronic variants beyond +7 (donor side) and -21 (acceptor side), +7 and -21 not included: +8 and beyond, -22 and beyond
extra_conditions: no splicing-prediction condition stated in the criterion's text; the instructions to use say BP4 may also be applied to reach Likely Benign
rules.quote: BP7: Use for synonymous and deep intronic variants defined as further than (but not including) +7 and further than (but not including) -21 at donor and acceptor sites, respectively.

further_quotes.quote: May also apply BP4 to achieve Likely Benign

extra_conditions: VarSeak class 4 or class 5 (not in this study's panel: not evaluated; the instructions to use allow SpliceAI alone where VarSeak cannot take the variant)
rules.quote: For splice variants, concordance of Splice AI (>0.5) and VarSeak (class 4 or class 5).

further_quotes.quote: The Splice AI score alone can be applied if VarSeak is unable to accept the variant type.

rules.position_scope: variants assessed for splicing impact (no position stated)
extra_conditions: VarSeak class 1 or class 2 (not in this study's panel: not evaluated; the instructions to use allow SpliceAI alone where VarSeak cannot take the variant)
rules.quote: BP4 can be applied to assess lack of splicing impact, with concordance of Splice AI (≤0.1) and VarSeak (Class 1 or Class 2).

further_quotes.quote: The Splice AI score alone can be applied if VarSeak is unable to accept the variant type.

rules.tool: SpliceAI and VarSeak through BP4; PhyloP
rules.position_scope: silent or intronic variants (no position stated)
rules.quote: If BP4 is met for lack of splice effect, BP7 can be applied to silent or intronic variants where the PhyloP score is ≤0.2.
